title: OpenCode Makes GLM 5.3 Flash AI Model Free
summary:
DeepSeek v4.1 Flash previously served as the primary no-cost language model for users of the OpenCode development environment. This selection grew on October 16 when the platform removed all charges for the GLM 5.3 Flash model, granting all users access to the high-speed AI tool without subscription fees.

The decision to offer GLM 5.3 Flash for free expands the library of no-cost assets available to developers on the platform. This follows a similar move to make the DeepSeek v4.1 Flash model complimentary, signaling a strategy to increase the availability of lightweight AI models.
